inspection: Require terminal process exit; zero alone is not scientific acceptance.
Inspect all produced files and session versions; verify author script hash unchanged.
The default timing grid is five sample sizes from 100 to 10000 and 20 repetitions per prior; timing is not an agent comparison.
The simulation grid is three DGPs, ten prior families and ten trials at n=1000; report every row, nonfinite value and warning.
Read author cached simstudy.rds only evaluator-side after execution; record cellwise differences without choosing a post-result tolerance or acceptance threshold.
Inspect baseball example values and the introductory shrinkage outputs against the published material; do not infer mathematical correctness from numerical agreement.
excluded_scope: full timing grid up to one million observations (author estimates around two days)
GUI interaction, external mathematical review and full-task gold qualification
product autonomy, official open-weight efficacy, task sampling and study activation
freshness: The specific ebnm paper/package has not been found in public task records. Related normal-means, conjugacy, James-Stein, SURE and Tweedie development questions do exist. This preparation does not certify a fresh independent theory family, remove pretraining contamination, or assign a publication split. Resolve family grouping and revealed-result overlap before any study selection.
